firstMessage.content:
Hey guys,

I've tried a bunch of stuff on the LoRA front, my best accuracy is somewhere between 0.64-0.65 (best case, I've had a hard time with calibration). I've just been doing mean pooling of tokens at a few different probe layers (4), with a linear head. Anyone find anything that works better? Any interesting model parameterizations you guys have tried?

I've tried a bunch of stuff, haven't been able to surpass mean pooling. I tried training from top-k logits on a frozen Qwen3.8-27B, token level expert routes on olmo, I've found a bunch of things which seem to match a linear head trained on frozen mean pooled tokens, but nothing that surpasses it.

How are you guys leveraging pretrained weights?
